text_block_list.text:
Less than one month remains until the
Arima
Kinen. There's just one problem...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's running is stiff.
Everything about
her just seems rigid.
Now that the showdown is
almost here,
it seems she's feeling the pressure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's take a couple deep breaths to relax.

text_block_list.text: Okay.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Breathe in. Breathe out.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We're almost out of track time, and the
other
Umamusume are starting to wrap
things up. I need
to figure something out
fast...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: BREATHE IIIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: And BREATHE OOOUT!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Come on, Hayahide! Do it with me! IIIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's a fine line between being helpful and obnoxious, dummy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Lift your head up, Hayahide. Slouching
like that
makes it look bigger than usual.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What?! My head's perfectly—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There, your back just straightened out.
That
should make it easier for you to
breathe.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Whatever. I didn't come here for thanks.
I only
said it because she's hogging the
track, and
everyone's waiting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Your time slot's almost over, and you
two are just
standing around like you
own the place.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, Taishin! You're the one
who was all,
"Oh no, let's go see what's
wrong with Hayahide!"
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Shut up. I never said that...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You're lucky to have such good friends.

text_block_list.text:
I really am. They're almost too good for
me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we all go for one more
lap and
end today's training with a
bang?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Seriously?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Come on you guys! Let's gooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Deeerbyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she noticed the Derby's over
already...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be Ticket if she didn't shout
random
things all the time. Besides, her
energy always
cheers me up.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm so grateful to have met you two.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, okay, that's very sweet and
everything.
Anyway...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You gonna run or what?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hehe, count me in!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Forgetting all about their agreement to
run just
one lap, the three friends keep
going until time
runs out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: HA-YA-HI-DE!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... We're using names as a
running
chant now?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: TIII-CKET! TAAAI-SHIN!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Seriously?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Hey, it's not bad! Besides, the act
of
vocalizing has a demonstrable effect
on gross
motor movements.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But more than that, shouting your names
really
motivates me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you're losing your mind
too...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So? Are we gonna catch up to the wild
child or
what?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Let's do it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ, Уиннинг Тикит, and
Narita
Taishin keep racing around the
track without a
care in the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wha?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Did I do that right? I could've sworn that
was the
right time to yell...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Hahaha! Nah, that was perfect.
Come on,
let's run.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: See ya!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hey! No fair, Taishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Mind if I go too, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Go for it! Get that W!

text_block_list.text: Roger!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ chases after Winning
Ticket and
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She ends up crossing the finish line first
despite
their head start.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the tension seems to melt from Biwa

Hayahide's shoulders, and her form
looks great
once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems her friends' shouts of
encouragement
have a positive effect on
Hayahide, who can't
stop grinning.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
